name: Complete checkout end-to-end with a single item
description: Validates the full Cart Review → Checkout Information → Order Overview → Order Completion happy path end-to-end for a single-item cart, as an overall smoke/regression check of AC1–AC4.
precondition: Fresh browser session; user is not yet logged in.

test_steps.description: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com and log in with `standard_user` / `secret_sauce`
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page)

test_steps.description: Click "Add to cart" for Sauce Labs Backpack
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "1"; button changes to "Remove"

test_steps.description: Click the cart icon to open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: `cart.html` lists Sauce Labs Backpack with quantity 1, description, and price $29.99

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html` ("Checkout: Your Information")

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "Jane", Last Name "Smith", Zip "12345", click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` ("Checkout: Overview")

test_steps.description: Review the Overview page
test_steps.expected_result: Sauce Labs Backpack line item (qty 1, $29.99) shown; Payment Information "SauceCard #31337" shown; Shipping Information "Free Pony Express Delivery!" shown; Item total $29.99, Tax $2.40 (8%), Total $32.39

test_steps.description: Click "Finish"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`; heading "Thank you for your order!" is displayed; cart badge shows empty

test_steps.description: Click "Back Home"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page)

name: Complete checkout with multiple items and verify price arithmetic
description: Confirms subtotal, tax (resolves OQ4: 8% of item subtotal), and total arithmetic are correct for a multi-item cart, and that order completion succeeds.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; empty cart at start.

test_steps.description: Add Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light to the cart
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "2"

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: Both items listed with quantity 1 each and correct individual prices

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout", fill in valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User reaches the Overview page listing both items

test_steps.description: Read the "Item total", "Tax", and "Total" values
test_steps.expected_result: Item total = $39.98 (29.99+9.99); Tax = $3.20 (8% of $39.98, rounded); Total = $43.18 (item total + tax)

test_steps.description: Click "Finish"
test_steps.expected_result: Order completes successfully and the cart is cleared

name: Cart page displays full item details for each product
description: Verifies each cart line item shows name, description, price, and quantity as required by AC1/FR1.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`.

test_steps.description: Add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart, open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: Item name "Sauce Labs Backpack" visible; item description text visible; item price "$29.99" visible; item quantity "1" visible

name: Cart page offers Continue Shopping and Checkout options
description: Confirms both navigation options required by AC1 are present, enabled, and that Continue Shopping preserves cart state.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; at least one item in cart.

test_steps.description: Add any item, open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: "Continue Shopping" button visible and enabled; "Checkout" button visible and enabled

test_steps.description: Click "Continue Shopping"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html`; cart badge count is unchanged (item still in cart)

name: [DISCREPANCY] Cart page does not display a total/subtotal price
description: Documents a confirmed live-application defect where the Cart page omits the total price calculation mandated by FR2.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; two items with different prices in cart.

test_steps.description: Add two items with different prices, open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: No subtotal, tax, or total price element is present anywhere on `cart.html` — only the two individual item prices are shown. Flag as a confirmed requirement-vs-implementation gap against FR2, not a silently accepted pass.

name: Submitting an entirely empty form shows First Name required error first
description: Validates mandatory-field enforcement (BR1/FR7) surfaces the correct field-specific error (FR8) when all fields are empty.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; item in cart; on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Reach `checkout-step-one.html` via Cart → Checkout
test_steps.expected_result: Checkout Information form is displayed

test_steps.description: Leave all three fields empty, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert reads "Error: First Name is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`

name: Leaving only Last Name empty shows Last Name required error
description: Validates per-field mandatory validation and correct field-specific error message ordering.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name only, leave Last Name and Zip empty, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert reads "Error: Last Name is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`

name: Leaving only Zip/Postal Code empty shows Postal Code required error
description: Validates the third mandatory field's individual validation message.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name and Last Name, leave Zip empty, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert reads "Error: Postal Code is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`

name: Valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip proceed to Overview page
description: Confirms the positive path for AC2 — valid mandatory data allows progression to the Overview page with no error.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "Jane", Last Name "Smith", Zip "12345", click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`; no error alert is shown

name: Error alert can be dismissed via its close control
description: Confirms the required-field error alert's dismiss (X) control clears the alert without losing form state.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Click "Continue" with all fields empty to trigger the required-field error
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert is visible

test_steps.description: Click the "Dismiss error" (X) control on the alert
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert is no longer visible; form fields remain empty and editable

name: [DISCREPANCY] Special characters in Zip/Postal Code are accepted without a format validation error
description: Documents a confirmed live-application defect where invalid/special-character Zip input is silently accepted instead of being rejected.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "John", Last Name "Doe", Zip "!@#$%", click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: No format-validation error is shown; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` despite the invalid Zip value. Flag as a confirmed gap against FR23/FR24/AC5.

name: [DISCREPANCY] Whitespace-only First Name is accepted as valid
description: Documents a confirmed live-application defect where a First Name consisting only of spaces bypasses mandatory-field enforcement.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name as three spaces "   ", Last Name "Doe", Zip "12345", click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: No "First Name is required" error is shown even though the field is effectively blank; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`. Flag as a confirmed gap against FR7/BR1 and the intent of AC5.

name: [DISCREPANCY] Oversized name input and special-character Last Name are both accepted
description: Documents a confirmed live-application defect showing no max-length or allowed-character validation exists on First Name / Last Name.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter a First Name of 90+ characters, a Last Name containing digits and special characters ("Doe123!@#"), and a valid Zip, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: No length-limit or character-format error is shown for either field; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`. Confirms no max-length/allowed-character validation exists, contradicting the intent of FR23/FR24/AC5.

name: Numeric 5-digit Zip/Postal Code is accepted (happy-path boundary)
description: Positive boundary check confirming a well-formed 5-digit numeric Zip is accepted without error.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter valid First Name and Last Name, Zip "99999", click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` with no errors

name: Overview page lists all cart items with correct details
description: Confirms the order summary on the Overview page accurately reflects all cart items as a read-only summary.
precondition: Logged in; two items in cart; valid checkout information submitted.

test_steps.description: Add both items to the cart and proceed through checkout information with valid data to reach `checkout-step-two.html`
test_steps.expected_result: Both items listed with correct name, quantity (1 each), and price; no "Add to cart"/"Remove" controls shown on this read-only summary

name: Overview page displays Payment and Shipping information sections
description: Confirms both required informational sections are present on the Overview page (per Assumption A3, this is static/demo data, not a payment-entry step).
precondition: On `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item.

test_steps.description: Reach `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item in the cart
test_steps.expected_result: "Payment Information:" section shows "SauceCard #31337"; "Shipping Information:" section shows "Free Pony Express Delivery!"

name: Overview page provides Cancel and Finish controls
description: Confirms both required action controls are present and enabled on the Overview page.
precondition: On `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item.

test_steps.description: Reach `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item in the cart
test_steps.expected_result: "Cancel" button visible and enabled; "Finish" button visible and enabled

name: Finish redirects to confirmation page with success message
description: Confirms order completion produces the required confirmation page, success message, and Back Home control.
precondition: On `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item.

test_steps.description: Complete checkout information and reach `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item, click "Finish"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`; heading "Thank you for your order!" displayed; descriptive dispatch/delivery text displayed; "Back Home" button visible

name: Back Home button returns to the Products page
description: Confirms the Back Home navigation target required by FR21.
precondition: On `checkout-complete.html`.

test_steps.description: Reach `checkout-complete.html` by completing an order
test_steps.expected_result: Confirmation page displayed

test_steps.description: Click "Back Home"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page); product grid is displayed

name: Cart is cleared after order confirmation
description: Confirms BR4/FR22 — the cart is emptied once an order is successfully completed.
precondition: Logged in; two items in cart.

test_steps.description: Add two items to the cart, complete checkout through "Finish" to reach `checkout-complete.html`
test_steps.expected_result: Cart icon shows no item count badge ("Cart, empty")

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page directly
test_steps.expected_result: Cart page shows zero line items

name: Unauthenticated direct access to checkout is blocked and redirected to login
description: Confirms BR2/FR26 — checkout is restricted to logged-in users, verified via direct URL access while unauthenticated.
precondition: Not logged in (or explicitly logged out via the hamburger menu "Logout" link).

test_steps.description: Without logging in, navigate directly to https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-one.html
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page ("/"); error alert reads: "Epic sadface: You can only access '/checkout-step-one.html' when you are logged in."

name: [DISCREPANCY] Checking out with an empty cart is not blocked and can be completed with a $0.00 total
description: Documents a confirmed live-application defect where BR3/FR27 (cart cannot be empty when proceeding to checkout) is not enforced anywhere in the flow, allowing a $0 order to complete end-to-end.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user` with a guaranteed-empty cart.

test_steps.description: Log in with a guaranteed-empty cart, open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: "Checkout" button is present and enabled even though the cart has zero items

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout"
test_steps.expected_result: User is unexpectedly redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html` instead of being blocked or shown an empty-cart message — contradicts FR27/BR3

test_steps.description: Fill in valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User reaches `/checkout-step-two.html` showing "Item total: $0", "Tax: $0.00", "Total: $0.00", and no line items

test_steps.description: Click "Finish"
test_steps.expected_result: Order completes successfully and `/checkout-complete.html` is shown, confirming an order with zero items was allowed end-to-end. Flag as a confirmed defect against FR27/BR3.

name: Logged-in session persists across checkout steps for a valid multi-step flow
description: Confirms no re-authentication is required mid-flow for an authenticated session.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; item in cart.

test_steps.description: Progress through Cart → Checkout Info → Overview → Complete without logging out
test_steps.expected_result: No re-authentication is required at any step; each page transition succeeds without redirect to login

name: [DISCREPANCY] Attempting to check out again immediately after order completion (empty cart) reproduces the same empty-cart defect
description: Confirms the FR27/BR3 gap from TC-10345-022 is reproducible immediately after a legitimate order, not a one-off condition.
precondition: Cart has just been emptied by completing a prior order.

test_steps.description: Complete a full order for one item so the cart becomes empty, click "Checkout" again from the now-empty cart page
test_steps.expected_result: The application again allows navigation to `checkout-step-one.html` despite zero items, reproducing the FR27/BR3 gap rather than showing any "cart is empty" guard message

name: Cancel from Checkout Information page returns to Cart page with items preserved
description: Confirms BR5/FR28's "cancel at any step, return to cart" rule holds for the information-entry step, and resolves OQ2 (a step-one Cancel control does exist, contrary to the requirement report's noted ambiguity).
precondition: Logged in; two items in cart; on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Add two items to the cart, click "Checkout" to reach `checkout-step-one.html`
test_steps.expected_result: Checkout Information form is displayed

test_steps.description: Click "Cancel" on the Checkout Information page
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/cart.html`; both items are still present with correct quantities and prices

name: [DISCREPANCY] Cancel from Checkout Overview page returns to Products page, not the Cart page
description: Documents a confirmed asymmetry: BR5/FR28 implies cancellation returns the user to the cart, but the Overview-page Cancel lands on the Products page instead (cart contents are still preserved).
precondition: Logged in; two items in cart; valid checkout info submitted; on `checkout-step-two.html`.

test_steps.description: Add two items to the cart, proceed through valid checkout information to reach `checkout-step-two.html`
test_steps.expected_result: Overview page displayed

test_steps.description: Click "Cancel" on the Checkout Overview page
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page), NOT `/cart.html` — inconsistent with the step-one Cancel destination and with BR5's implied "return to cart" behavior. Cart badge still shows the original item count, confirming cart contents are preserved even though the landing page differs.

name: [DISCREPANCY] Browser back button after order confirmation shows a stale Overview page whose Finish button is still clickable
description: Documents a confirmed defect: no safeguard exists against re-visiting/re-submitting a completed order via browser back navigation (addresses OQ6, which the source requirement document left undefined).
precondition: A single-item order has just been completed (`checkout-complete.html` reached).

test_steps.description: Complete a full order for one item to reach `checkout-complete.html`, click the browser Back button
test_steps.expected_result: Browser navigates to `/checkout-step-two.html` showing an empty/zero-value order summary (cart already cleared); "Finish" button is still present and enabled

test_steps.description: Click "Finish" again
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected back to `/checkout-complete.html` without any error, confirming no safeguard exists against re-submitting after order completion via back navigation

name: Full checkout flow renders and completes at a mobile viewport (375x667)
description: Exercises the full checkout flow at a mobile viewport. Scope caveat: unlike the sibling SCRUM-101 story, this requirement report (10345) contains no Technical Notes/Definition of Done section and explicitly logs cross-browser/mobile-responsiveness coverage as undefined (see R6, OQ8). This test case is retained because it is part of the reused test plan, but its result should not be treated as validating a documented 10345 requirement until OQ8 is resolved with the product owner.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`; browser viewport set to 375x667.

test_steps.description: Set the browser viewport to 375x667, log in as `standard_user`
test_steps.expected_result: Login form and hamburger menu icon render without horizontal overflow

test_steps.description: Add an item to the cart and proceed through Cart → Checkout Info → Overview → Complete at this viewport
test_steps.expected_result: All buttons and form fields remain visible, tappable, and functional at each step; no layout element is clipped or overlapping such that a user could not complete checkout

name: All checkout-flow validation and success messages are captured for content review
description: Captures the verbatim text of every validation and success message in the flow, supporting NFR2's "clear feedback" quality and FR8/FR19's message requirements.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Trigger each of: First Name required, Last Name required, Postal Code required, and the order-confirmation success message, capturing the exact text of each
test_steps.expected_result: "Error: First Name is required"; "Error: Last Name is required"; "Error: Postal Code is required"; "Thank you for your order!" success heading on `checkout-complete.html`; all messages recorded verbatim

name: Recover from a mandatory-field validation error and successfully proceed
description: Confirms FR25 — once invalid/missing checkout information has been corrected, the user can proceed normally.
precondition: On `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Leave all fields empty, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert reads "Error: First Name is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`

test_steps.description: Correct the form by entering valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` with no error alert, confirming FR25 (recovery after correction)

name: [OBSERVATION] Undocumented "Generate PDF order" button appears on the confirmation page
description: Records the presence of a "Generate PDF order" button on `checkout-complete.html` that is not referenced anywhere in this requirement report's functional requirements (FR18–FR22 only require the success message and Back Home button). This is logged as an observation for product-owner triage, not asserted as a pass/fail against any documented FR.
precondition: Order just completed; on `checkout-complete.html`.

test_steps.description: Reach `checkout-complete.html` by completing an order
test_steps.expected_result: A "Generate PDF order" button is visible, despite no FR in this report describing it. Log for product-owner review — undocumented functionality, not a pass/fail defect against a stated requirement.

name: [OBSERVATION] No quantity selector exists; multi-quantity line items are unachievable via the UI
description: Confirms that the requirement report's own edge case ("varying quantities") cannot be exercised because the product catalog/cart provide no quantity-selector control — each product can only be added as a single unit per line item.
precondition: Logged in as `standard_user`.

test_steps.description: Add a product to the cart and inspect the Cart page for a quantity control
test_steps.expected_result: No quantity selector/stepper is present; quantity is fixed at 1. Confirms the varying-quantity edge case from the requirement report cannot be exercised via the current UI — log as a scope limitation, not a functional defect.

name: [FLAGGED — NOT INDEPENDENTLY TESTABLE] NFR1 "secure" checkout has no concrete, verifiable control
description: Records that NFR1 ("the checkout process shall be secure") names no concrete, testable control (e.g., transport encryption, payment-data handling, session protection). Per the skill's "never assume undocumented behavior" rule, no pass/fail security assertion is written against this NFR; this test case exists solely to preserve traceability and surface the gap for product-owner clarification (OQ3).
precondition: N/A.

test_steps.description: Review NFR1 against the checkout flow for a concrete, testable security control
test_steps.expected_result: No concrete control is defined in the source document. Status: Blocked pending OQ3 resolution — no security assertion is made without a documented control to test against.

name: [BLOCKED — NOT EXECUTABLE] Session expiration mid-checkout
description: BR2 requires login to access checkout, but the source document does not define what should happen if a session expires mid-flow (OQ7). Per the "never assume undocumented behavior" rule, this test case is logged as Blocked rather than asserting an invented expected outcome.
precondition: N/A. Status: Blocked (not executable pending OQ7 clarification).

test_steps.description: (Not executable) Attempt to define a session-expiry-mid-checkout test
test_steps.expected_result: No expected behavior is documented anywhere in the source requirement report. Status: Blocked pending OQ7 resolution with the product owner — do not invent pass/fail criteria.
